name: Agro into mounted samurai
author: Piepet

notes: @abilities/repair.webp@ @building_military/barracks.webp@ + @building_japanese/farmhouse-1.webp@. Try not to block @landmark_japanese/kura-storehouse-1.webp@ by @abilities/repair.webp@ near @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@.
Produce 2 @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ to harass ennemy gold without overcomitting
Send 9 @resource/sheep.webp@@unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ to @resource/berrybush.webp@. The goal is to be greedy and save @resource/sheep.webp@ for safe later food source.

@abilities/repair.webp@@landmark_japanese/kura-storehouse-1.webp@ with only 1 @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@, send @resource/sheep.webp@@unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@ and @resource/rally.webp@ on @resource/resource_wood.webp@

When 3 @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ on @resource/resource_wood.webp@, @resource/rally.webp@ on @resource/sheep.webp@ and shift click @resource/resource_wood.webp@@unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ on @resource/sheep.webp@ (they just need to cut 1 tree to then @abilities/repair.webp@@building_defensive/outpost.webp@ on @resource/resource_gold.webp@)

@unit_cavalry/scout.webp@ ennemy and if danger is high then @technology_defensive/fortify-outpost.webp@. If not, save @resource/resource_stone.webp@ to get @technology_japanese/daimyo-manor-1.webp@ later.
Send the @age/age_2.webp@@unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ to use first @landmark_japanese/kura-storehouse-1.webp@@building_economy/farm.webp@ but pay attention to ennemy raids.

@abilities/repair.webp@@landmark_japanese/floating-gate-2.webp@ witth 7 @resource/resource_food.webp@@unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ and start collecting @resource/resource_wood.webp@ next to @landmark_japanese/kura-storehouse-1.webp@to @abilities/repair.webp@@building_military/stable.webp@.
Try to get a 2:1 ration on @resource/resource_food.webp@ / @resource/resource_gold.webp@ to constantly produce @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ + @unit_japanese/mounted-samurai-3.webp@

First @unit_japanese/shinto-priest-3.webp@ place @ability_japanese/ability-place-yorishiro.webp@ in the @building_military/stable.webp@ and then go grab @resource/relics.webp@. If can easily grab @resource/relics.webp@, put 3 more @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ on @resource/resource_wood.webp@ to @abilities/repair.webp@@building_japanese/shinto-shrine-3.webp@.

description: Good in every matchup except english/house of lancaster (villagers with bow), Rus (don't need gold but can maybe burn hunting cabins) and mongols (can outproduce spearmen)
